states.noAccessTitle: The finals console is for proctors
states.noAccessBody: This page needs the proctor role (final.proctor). If you are proctoring an in-person final, ask an administrator for the role; the olympiad operator then assigns you to a venue.
states.errBody: The server did not answer. Nothing you recorded is lost — try again in a moment.
states.nfTitle: This venue is not on your list
states.nfBody: You can only open venues you are assigned to as proctor. It may have been reassigned to someone else.

venues.title: My finals
venues.subtitle: The in-person venues you proctor. Check children in at the door, then run the final on the offline runner — it needs no internet.
venues.emptyTitle: No venue is assigned to you yet
venues.emptyBody: The olympiad operator assigns proctors to venues. As soon as you are assigned, the venue and its roster appear here.
venues.how1: Check each child in at the door and record who came with them.
venues.how2: While still online, download the package to the device the children will use.
venues.how3: Children take the final on that device — no internet needed.
venues.how4: When you are back online, upload the answers, or export them to a file and upload it later.

roster.runnerBody: Once the children are checked in, open the runner while you are still online and download the package. After that the final runs on that device without internet.
roster.listSub: Check the accompanying adult’s ID against the name shown for each child.
roster.emptyTitle: No children are registered at this venue
roster.emptyBody: Families choose a venue on their olympiad page. Children appear here as soon as they register.
roster.expectedAdult: Accompanying adult should be: {name} (profile owner) — check ID
roster.expectedUnknown: No profile owner on record — note who came.
roster.inMatch: Checked in — adult is the owner
roster.recordNote: This is a record, not a refusal: the child sits the final either way.
roster.undoBody: Possible only before the child has started. The record of the accompanying adult is cleared too.
roster.startedNote: The package is on the runner — undo is no longer possible.
roster.formMissingFmt: No form for grade {g} yet — ask the olympiad operator.

errors.ALREADY_STARTED: The child has already started (the package was downloaded), so the check-in can no longer be undone.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This child is no longer on the roster. Refresh the page.
errors.NETWORK: No connection — nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong — nothing was saved. Try again.

runner.title: Offline runner
runner.booting: Reading what is saved on this device…
runner.unsupported: This browser cannot keep data offline (storage is unavailable — a private window, or blocked site data). Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari in a normal window.
runner.storageError: This browser could not save to its storage (it may be full). Answers given since then are only in this tab — export them to a file before you close it.

prep.title: Prepare this device
prep.body: While online, download the package: the forms with every picture and sound, and one session for each checked-in child. No answer keys are downloaded.
prep.readyFmt: Ready offline: {n} children, forms cached, media included
prep.keepOpen: Keep this tab open. Do not reload or close it while offline: the runner is not installed on the device, so without internet the page cannot be opened again. Answers already given stay saved on this device either way.
prep.redownloadNote: Downloading again keeps the same sessions — nobody starts over. Check in latecomers on the roster first.
prep.needOnline: Connect to the internet to download the package.
prep.noChildren: No child is checked in yet. Check the children in on the roster, then download.
prep.notReadyFmt: The final’s form is not ready for grade {grades}. Ask the olympiad operator to attach it, then download again.

errors.NETWORK: The connection dropped during the download. Try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This venue is no longer assigned to you.
errors.SIGNED_OUT: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again while online, then come back here.
errors.UNKNOWN: The package could not be downloaded. Try again.

list.title: Children
list.sub: Tap a child, then hand them the device. One device can run the children one after another.
list.empty: Download the package to see the checked-in children here.

child.readySub: Work on your own. You can skip a question and come back to it, flag the ones you are unsure about, and review everything before you submit.
child.fTs: the clock starts when you press Start
child.resumeFmt: {n} of {m} answered — you carry on where you stopped.
child.notYouFmt: Not {name}? Give the device back to the proctor.
child.saved: Every answer is saved on this device as you go.
child.doneSub: Your answers are saved. You worked hard — time to rest.
child.doneTimeUp: Time ran out — your answers were handed in automatically.
child.doneNoScore: There is no score here. Your family will see the result once the olympiad publishes it.
child.doneHand: Give the device back to the proctor.

hold.label: Proctor: hold to return to the list
hold.hint: Press and hold for 2 seconds. The child’s clock keeps running.

outbox.title: Upload answers
outbox.sub: Finished finals wait here until the server confirms them. They stay on this device until you clear it.
outbox.none: No finished finals on this device yet.
outbox.autoNote: Uploading starts by itself when the internet comes back.
outbox.resultFmt: Uploaded: {synced}. Already on the server: {already}. Not accepted: {rejected}.

reasons.unknown: the session does not belong to this venue
reasons.answers: the answers do not match the form

errors.NETWORK: No internet. The answers stay on this device; uploading starts again when the connection is back.
errors.SIGNED_OUT: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again and upload — or export the answers to a file now.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This venue is no longer assigned to you. Export the answers to a file and contact the olympiad operator.
errors.UNKNOWN: The upload failed. The answers stay on this device — try again.

file.title: Answers as a file
file.body: If this device never gets online: export the answers to a file, copy it to any device, sign in there as yourself and upload it on this page.
file.exportNone: There is nothing to export yet.
file.badFile: This is not an answers file from the offline runner.
file.otherVenue: This file is for another venue. Open the runner of that venue to upload it.
file.emptyFile: This file has no finished finals in it.

clear.title: Clear this device
clear.body: Removes the package and every answer for this venue from this browser — do this after everything is uploaded.
clear.blockedFmt: {n} finals are not uploaded or not finished yet — upload or export them first.
clear.dlgBody: The package and every saved answer for this venue are removed from this browser. Uploaded finals are safe on the server.
clear.dlgRejectedFmt: {n} finals were not accepted by the server and will be lost from this device. Export them to a file first if you need them.
